extracted.name: Chorizo Queso Dip
extracted.description: This chorizo queso dip made with spicy bulk chorizo, tomatoes with chiles, and melted cheese simmers in a slow cooker for a crowd-pleasing appetizer.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers (such as RO*TEL®), drained
1 (8 ounce) package processed cheese (such as Velveeta®), cubed
instruction_lines: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir chorizo in the hot skillet until well browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes; drain well and transfer to a slow cooker.
Add diced tomatoes with chiles, cream cheese, and processed cheese to slow cooker; stir well. Cover and cook on Low until cheese has melted, stirring occasionally, about 1 ½ to 2 hours.
